topic.title: The rich pay themselves first: the same $4,000 paycheck, two orders

demand.title: What's a money move only rich people know that sounds completely insane?

cta: Who gets paid first on your payday? Comment
title: Payday: Sharma pays one bill before rent. Himself 🤫
description:
Who gets paid first on payday: the landlord, or the person who earned it?
The same $4,000 a month, two orders: saving whatever is left at month end (about $100) or moving 20% out on payday, both invested for 30 years at an assumed 7% a year, computed. The return is an assumption, not a promise; no account or product named. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
